title: Hysteretic Ternary State Tagging, Quasi-Newton Curvature Filtering, and Matrix-Free Lanczos Saddle Escape in Constrained Nonlinear Search (v1.0.0)
description: Falsifiable numerical optimization manuscript and zero-dependency NumPy benchmark suite evaluating dual-rail balanced-ternary RC hysteresis, rotated L-BFGS curvature filtering, 10-step HVP Lanczos (1,1) oblique mirror-saddle escape on 3D Stillinger AB-polymers, and 80-bit Fowler-packed 3D FCC island percolation.
